meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: 它会扫描你的代码库，从 9 个维度找技术债，每条问题都标出文件和行号，然后生成 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md，里面写明严重程度、修复工时估算和优先级排序。
howto.when: 当你要求做技术债审计、代码库健康检查等，或提到 “tech debt”、“code health” 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个仓库的技术债，输出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say.note: 会生成带文件行号引用的审计报告

say.text: 分析一下 src 目录的代码质量，按严重度排序
say.note: 问题按 Critical 到 Low 分级列出

say.text: 列出这个仓库 30 分钟内能修完的快速修复项
say.note: 报告里会有 Quick Wins 清单

howto.what_en: It scans your repo across 9 dimensions for technical debt, cites file:line:col for each finding, and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a tech debt audit, codebase health check, or similar, or mention terms like 'tech debt' or 'code health'.

say_en.text: Audit this repo's tech debt and write TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say_en.note: Produces an audit report with file citations

say_en.text: Check code quality in src and rank issues by severity
List quick wins I can fix in under 30 minutes
say_en.note: Fills in the Quick Wins checklist
